visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up of a pair of feet wearing colorful horizontally striped socks in shades of pink, green, and blue. The person is wearing plush white slippers adorned with light blue cloud and raindrop patterns. The floor is made of light-toned rectangular tiles. (2) The camera pans vertically upward across a light blue plush blanket. A white printed logo featuring a minimalist graphic of a girl's face with a bob haircut and the text 'PETIT' becomes visible in the center of the frame. (3) The shot transitions to a medium-wide shot of a young woman with long black hair and a fringe, sitting in a modern beige armchair. She is holding the blue blanket in front of her. The background is a white wall decorated with a green tinsel garland and warm yellow fairy lights arranged in a stylized Christmas tree shape. A light-colored wooden table sits to her side. (4) The woman settles into the chair and covers her legs with the blue blanket. She picks up a small bottle of nail polish from the wooden table. She wears a black top and a pink smartwatch on her left wrist. (5) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's hands as she unscrews a bottle of bright red nail polish. She carefully applies the lacquer to her fingernails. She is wearing delicate gold rings on her fingers. The bottle is clear with a white cap and the brand name 'PETIT' on the front. (6) The video concludes with the woman holding the nail polish bottle in front of her face, smiling warmly at the camera. She extends her fingers to show off her finished red manicure. The background remains the cozy, brightly lit indoor setting with the festive wall decoration.
